seo.title: Stash — keep the links, videos and notes you find
seo.description: Stash is a link keeper: paste a URL and it works out what it is — page, post, video, channel, repository or app — and files it, with a note attached, in a collection you can share.
seo.keywords: bookmark manager, link saver, read it later, collections, notes, self hosted
